item.name: Create a new campaign inside your Talkpush account

request.name: Create a new campaign inside your Talkpush account

description.content:
This endpoint lets you create a new campaign inside Talkpush. Not all the information required to set up a fully operational campaign can be provided via the API.  Permission settings, questions, message, smart filters and notifications need to set up from the campaign settings inside the CRM. 
A common use case for this endpoint would be the automatic creation of a campaign inside Talkpush when a user creates a job requisiton inside an integrated ATS.

info.name: Talkpush Agents API Campaigns API API

description.content: Production Base URL to be used during implementation: {your company workspace subdomain}.talkpush.com/api/talkpush_services With the Talkpush APIs you can instantly plug your lead source into out platform to enjoy the benefits of Talkpush. You can also synch your existing HR / Recruitment technology stack with your Talkpush account. To be able to use our API you will need pass an api key as a parameter for each API call. In case you do not know your current API key you can contact our support team at cs@talkpush.com. Contact Support: Email: admin@talkpush.com
